prompt: Which three North American countries will host the 2026 FIFA's Women World Cup, the first to be co-hosted by three nations and the first North American World Cup since 1994?
answer: Canada, Mexico, and the United States will co-host the **2026 FIFA World Cup**. It is the **men’s** World Cup—not the Women’s World Cup—and will be the first FIFA World Cup hosted by three countries since 1994’s North American tournament.
